name: Langtang Valley Trek
sub_region: Rasuwa District (Langtang National Park, Gosaikunda Rural Municipality), Bagmati Province

difficulty.notes: Up and back along the Langtang Khola; highest sleep at Kyanjin Gompa (3,870 m). Optional summit day to Kyanjin Ri (4,773 m, approx. 900 m gain) or the longer, steeper Tserko Ri (4,984 m, approx. 1,100 m gain, 7-9 hours round trip). [s6, s7, s8]

duration_days.notes: 7 days without a summit day; 8 days with Kyanjin Ri or Tserko Ri; 9-10 days with both viewpoints (two nights extra at Kyanjin); 10-12 days with hotel nights/city tour; can be extended to Gosainkunda and Helambu (see langtang-gosainkunda-trek). Since the 26 Aug 2026 Bhote Koshi flood, the walk starts from Dhunche or Thulo Syabru rather than Syabrubesi. [s5, s7, s9]

max_altitude_point: Tserko Ri (optional; Kyanjin Ri 4,773 m is the shorter alternative; highest overnight Kyanjin Gompa 3,870 m)
start_point: Syabrubesi (approx. 1,460 m); post-flood 2026: Dhunche or Thulo Syabru
end_point: Syabrubesi (same route back), or Dhunche/Thulo Syabru in 2026

itinerary.notes: Approx. 122 km, 7-9 hours by bus/jeep. Syabrubesi given as 1,460-1,550 m. In Oct 2026 no hotels were running in Syabrubesi after the flood; operators walk on from the road head or start from Dhunche/Thulo Syabru. [s6, s7, s11]
Lama Hotel given as 2,380-2,470 m. [s6, s8, s9]

itinerary.route: Lama Hotel - Ghoda Tabela - Langtang village
itinerary.notes: Army and park post at Ghoda Tabela. Langtang village was rebuilt after it was buried by an earthquake-triggered avalanche on 25 April 2015. [s7, s8]

itinerary.route: Day hike to Tserko Ri (4,984 m) or Kyanjin Ri (4,773 m), return to Kyanjin Gompa

best_seasons.notes: NTB lists Oct-Nov and Mar-May as best. Access was cut by the 26 Aug 2026 Bhote Koshi flood; road access to Dhunche resumed after the Betrawati Bailey bridge opened on 11 Oct 2026, and the trail into the valley was reported repaired in mid-October. The Syabrubesi road bridge and much of the bazaar remained destroyed. [s3, s4, s5, s12]

permits.name: Langtang National Park entry permit
permits.fee: NPR 3,000 per person per entry (SAARC NPR 1,500; Nepali NPR 100; under 10 free)

permits.name: TIMS card (agency-issued e-TIMS)
permits.applies_to: foreign nationals; Langtang Trek is on NTB's mandatory guide + TIMS list

guide_requirements: NTB lists the Langtang Trek under the revised TIMS provision effective 31 March 2023: trekkers must be accompanied by a licensed trekking guide and carry an agency-issued TIMS card. [s2]

drives: Kathmandu - Trishuli - Betrawati - Dhunche - Syabrubesi: approx. 122 km, 7-9 hours by bus or jeep (Betrawati Bailey bridge opened 11 Oct 2026 after flood damage)
logistics.notes: Permit checks at Dhunche (army/park) and Ghoda Tabela; the Syabrubesi checkpoint was reported swept away in the Aug 2026 flood. Helicopter landing in the park carries an extra NPR 3,000 landing fee per an operator source. [s7, s10]

highlights: Kyanjin Gompa monastery and cheese factory beneath Langtang Lirung (approx. 7,227-7,234 m)
Tserko Ri and Kyanjin Ri viewpoints
Rebuilt Langtang village and Tamang/Tibetan-Buddhist culture
Closest major Himalayan valley trek to Kathmandu by road
Langtang National Park wildlife such as red panda and Himalayan tahr
risks: Road and trail damage from floods/landslides (Aug 2026 Bhote Koshi flood)
Altitude on the Tserko Ri day (approx. 4,984 m)
Landslide and avalanche hazard in the valley (2015 earthquake disaster)

acclimatization.notes: The Kyanjin Ri/Tserko Ri day doubles as the acclimatization day; arriving early at Kyanjin and doing the summit the next day is advised. [s8]

unverified: Syabrubesi altitude (1,460 vs 1,503-1,550 m) and Lama Hotel altitude (2,380 vs 2,470 m) differ between sources.
Langtang Lirung height given as 7,227 m and 7,234 m in different sources.
Post-flood access details (start from Dhunche/Thulo Syabru, no lodges at Syabrubesi) are from operator updates dated mid-October 2026 and may change.
NPR 3,000 helicopter landing fee in Langtang NP is from a single operator site.
